compatibility: The native PNG plates can replace report backgrounds at the same logical size. No foreground positions change. Staggered rows repeat at the source row height. City/attitude/trade include even/odd scroll-phase alternatives: the game chooses icon columns from the absolute row index, so one fixed plate cannot track an odd scroll. Selecting the matching plate needs a small loader/render change; the supplied first-page mockups use phase zero. Runtime resizing, alternate fonts or different pagination require matching plates or dynamic bands; do not scale a fixed plate independently of its text.
sharedSourceResource: Top Cities and Hall of Fame use tiles.dll/57 and deliberately have identical native plates. Enhanced plates differ. Defense/casualties share resource 51 with other history views, so applying their patterned plates globally needs per-window background selection; their preview plates are not a universal resource replacement.
